'''Pilgrim''' was the term given by the [[Ugor/Legends|Ugor]] to any visitor to the [[Paradise system/Legends|Paradise system]]. As Pilgrims, they were required to pay a donation to enter the system, and any junk or scrap they intended to remove was referred to as [[Holy Artifact]]s.<ref name="Scavenger Hunt">[[Scavenger Hunt (adventure)|''Scavenger Hunt'']]</ref>
